total_sites.description: Every manufactured-home site, occupied or vacant; the per-site denominator.

occupied_sites.description: Sites under in-place leases, no more than total_sites.

park_owned_homes.description: Homes owned by the community on its sites, no more than total_sites.

weighted_pad_rent_monthly.description: Stated, source-backed site-count-weighted monthly pad rent across all sites, vacant at stated asking rent; excludes home rent, fees and reimbursements. Document currency.

poh_home_rent_monthly.description: Monthly home rent per park-owned home across all owned homes, vacant at stated asking rent; excludes pad rent. Required when homes exist; absent or null otherwise.

as_of_date.description: Presence only in first scope. Date validity is a separate core RFC.
